decisions.reason: Candidate English statements are narrator reports of what al-As said, rather than full direct first-person quotations. Preserve quotation context using assertion mode and speaker metadata; type 13 specifically requires quoted first-person statement.
decisions.alternatives_rejected: Do not automatically assign command/description/prediction as adopted claims: the reported speech layer is essential.

decisions.reason: Narrator describes a revelation occurrence; statement must retain reported attribution rather than assert independent historical causation.
